Mercury.retrogradeEnergy: Miscommunication, delays, tech glitches, revisiting the past
Mercury.frequency: 3–4 times per year, about 3 weeks each
goodFor: Reconnecting with people from the past
avoid: Making assumptions about what someone meant
Mercury.witchTip: Triple-check messages before sending. Mercury retrograde is not cursed — it's a built-in editing phase. Use it.

Venus.directEnergy: Love, beauty, pleasure, money, harmony, relationships
Venus.retrogradeEnergy: Re-evaluating relationships, old flames resurface, beauty/money disruptions
avoid: New love spells (revisit old ones instead)
Venus.candle: Pink — gentle self-love; Green — reassessing value
Venus.witchTip: Exes may reappear. This is not a sign to reunite — it's a chance to see how much you've grown. Also a great time to declutter your closet and your heart.

Mars.retrogradeEnergy: Frustration, stalled projects, redirected anger, low physical energy
Mars.candle: Blue — cooling anger; Black — absorbing frustrated energy
Mars.witchTip: Your engine is idling, not dead. Redirect anger into creative work. This is rest, not failure.

Jupiter.directEnergy: Expansion, luck, abundance, growth, optimism, higher learning
Jupiter.retrogradeEnergy: Internal growth, re-evaluating beliefs, spiritual deepening
Jupiter.candle: Purple — spiritual growth; Blue — inner wisdom
Jupiter.witchTip: Luck turns inward. The growth happening now is invisible but real — like roots in winter.

Saturn.directEnergy: Discipline, structure, karma, responsibility, boundaries, time
Saturn.retrogradeEnergy: Karmic review, loosening restrictions, re-examining commitments
goodFor: Reviewing boundaries — too rigid or too loose?
Breaking patterns that no longer serve
Saturn.candle: Black — karmic clearing; Dark purple — deep restructuring
Saturn.witchTip: Saturn retrograde loosens the chains you forgot you were wearing. Notice which rules you follow out of habit vs. choice.

Uranus.directEnergy: Revolution, sudden change, innovation, freedom, awakening
Uranus.retrogradeEnergy: Internal revolution, reviewing where you need freedom, delayed breakthroughs
Uranus.candle: Electric blue or violet — inner awakening
Uranus.witchTip: The revolution is internal first. What do you actually want to be free from?

Neptune.directEnergy: Dreams, illusion, spirituality, compassion, the unconscious
Neptune.retrogradeEnergy: Clarity through disillusionment, seeing through deception, spiritual grounding
avoid: Starting new spiritual commitments without discernment
Neptune.candle: Sea green — clarity from the depths; White — truth
Neptune.witchTip: The fog lifts. What you see underneath might not be pretty, but it's real. Prefer real.

Pluto.directEnergy: Transformation, power, death/rebirth, the shadow, the unconscious depths
Pluto.retrogradeEnergy: Deep internal transformation, power dynamics review, shadow integration
Pluto.candle: Black — death of the old; Deep red — rebirth from ashes
Pluto.witchTip: Pluto retrograde is composting season. What died this year? Let it rot. It's feeding something.
